turns.text: In September 2026 (last month), the Average Order Value (AOV) was **€114.39**, based on 110 non-cancelled orders totalling €12,582.75 in revenue. Assumed 'last month' refers to September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) given the reference date of 5 October 2026, and excluded cancelled orders.

args.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount) / COUNT(order_id), 2) AS average_order_value_eur,
       SUM(amount) AS total_revenue_eur,
       COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01'
  AND order_date < '2026-10-01'
  AND status != 'cancelled';
